title: Claude Inbox Zero
oneLineOutcome: My goal was to build a cheap AI email assistant based off of Inbox Zero. TLDR: every run, it triages my Gmail inbox, labels threads under an InboxZero/ namespace, and drafts replies in my voice for threads that need a response. I added a feedback loop so it continuously improves to sound like me — it studies my sent mail and diffs its drafts against what I actually sent. It also hunts the zombie subscriptions I never open, and ends each run with a digest of what needs me, what got filed, and what to unsubscribe from.
